description: This is a source file implementing various commands related to 'git reflog', including showing, listing, deleting, expiring, checking existence, dropping, and writing reflog entries. It includes command parsing, interaction with repository references, and managing reflog data.

methods.name: int collect_reflog(const char * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Collects reflog references from a worktree, avoiding shared refs in non-current worktrees, and appends them to a string list.

methods.name: int expire_unreachable_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Callback to parse and set expiry for unreachable reflog entries.

methods.name: int expire_total_callback(const struct option * opt,const char * arg,int unset)
methods.description: Callback to parse and set total expiry for reflog entries.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_show(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog show' subcommand, displaying reflog entries.

methods.name: int show_reflog(const char * refname,void * cb_data UNUSED)
methods.description: Displays a single reflog reference name.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_list(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog list' subcommand, listing reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_expire(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog expire' subcommand, expiring reflog entries based on criteria.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_delete(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog delete' subcommand, deleting specified reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_exists(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo UNUSED)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog exists' subcommand, checking if reflog exists.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_drop(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog drop' subcommand, dropping reflogs.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog_write(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repo)
methods.description: Handles the 'git reflog write' subcommand, adding an entry to the reflog.

methods.name: int cmd_reflog(int argc,const char ** argv,const char * prefix,struct repository * repository)
methods.description: Main command dispatcher for 'git reflog', routing to subcommands.
